verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official JavaScript SDK for web event tracking and claims 16 SDKs that send standardized data, with an event-spec docs section and an HTTP API for sending events. However, the pack never names its mobile or server SDKs and never quotes the track/identify/page methods of the tracking spec. missing for 10: explicit evidence of official mobile and server SDKs, documentation of the track/identify/page spec calls, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform collection.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)

citations.quote: RudderStack's JavaScript SDK lets you track customer event data from your website and send it to your specified destinations.
With over 200 pre-built integrations, including 16 SDKs, you can connect new data sources to your entire stack in a matter of minutes.
Instrument one RudderStack SDK and automatically send standardized data to hundreds of destinations
Send event data from source to connected destinations
